title: NASA Saturn satellite sheet: Hyperion (VII) mass 0.056×10^20 kg, radius 180 x 133 x 103 km
summary: The Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Hyperion (VII) at mass 0.056 × 10^20 kg and radius 180 x 133 x 103 km.
body: NASA's Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Hyperion (VII) with mass 0.056 × 10^20 kg, radius 180 x 133 x 103 km, mean density 550 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.3. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semi-major axis (10 3 km) = 1,500.93; Semi-major axis (Saturnian Radii) = 24.904; Orbital Period* (days) = 21.276609; Rotation Period (days) = C; Inclination (degrees) = 0.43; Eccentricity = 0.1042. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 22 July 2025.
